intro: This page covers MIA’s official Dolphin, Flamingo, and Ibis garages, terminal valet, and the Economy Park & Ride lot, with rates copied from the official miami-airport.com parking page on November 25, 2026. The garages cap at $25 per day, valet at $39, and the Economy Park & Ride at $12 plus a $0.35 transaction fee; only the Dolphin and Flamingo garages can be pre-paid online, with a non-refundable $2.99 reservation fee. Below the official lots are nine off-airport options: Park ’N Fly by The Parking Spot, the off-airport operator the official MIA parking page links to, and eight nearby hotels whose own pages describe a park-and-fly or park-stay offer (Element, two Sonesta hotels, and five Hilton-family hotels). MIA has few independent shuttle lots that publish their own booking pages, so this sample leans on hotels; it is not every lot near the airport. Hotel shuttle hours vary and several stop overnight, so check before an early or late flight. Rates are dated snapshots, not live quotes.

officialLots.name: Dolphin Garage
officialLots.access: Walk to Concourses D and E; the official page says to use it when flying American Airlines, British Airways, JetBlue, or Qatar Airways

hours.notes: The official parking page lists rates, garage locations, and a 45-day maximum stay but does not publish garage operating hours.

officialLots.prebookRate: Online pre-pay offered for the Dolphin and Flamingo garages up to a year in advance; the price is shown at booking and a $2.99 reservation fee is non-refundable
officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: $2.00 per 20-minute increment up to the $25 daily maximum
officialLots.rateNotes: Official rates as listed on 2026-11-25. Maximum stay 45 days (vehicles are towed after 45 days). Payment: cash, Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover, Apple Pay, Samsung Pay. MIA Quick Pay stations let you pre-pay before reaching the exit lane. Reservations can be changed or cancelled up to 24 hours before the reservation time; with a reservation, scan the emailed QR code at the entrance instead of pulling a ticket.
officialLots.heightRestriction: 7' 0" (vehicles over 7 feet are directed to the Ibis Garage high-vehicle area or the Economy Park & Ride lot)
officialLots.visitNotes: Valet drop-off is on the Departures (2nd) level. A parking guidance system shows open spaces with green lights. Accessible parking is on the ground level and Level 3; motorcycle parking is on the first floor ($12 per day). Garage questions: 305-876-7536.

officialLots.name: Economy Park & Ride Lot
officialLots.area: Surface lot at 1350 NW 45 Ave, west of the terminals
officialLots.access: Shuttle bus to and from the MIA terminals 24 hours a day, per the official page

hours.notes: The official page does not publish lot hours; it says the shuttle bus to and from the terminals runs 24 hours a day. About 350 spaces, availability varies.

officialLots.driveUpDailyMax: $12.00 maximum per day, plus a $0.35 convenience fee per transaction
officialLots.prebookRate: No reservation is offered for this lot on the official page
officialLots.hourlyOrIncrement: $2.00 for each 20 minutes or part thereof, up to $12.00 per day

officialLots.heightRestriction: The official page lists this lot as an option for vehicles over 7 feet
officialLots.visitNotes: Uncovered surface lot with accessible parking on the ground level. The lowest official daily rate at MIA as listed on 2026-11-25.

listings.name: Park ’N Fly by The Parking Spot Miami (MIA)
listings.area: NW 28th St just across FL-953 (LeJeune Rd) from the airport, a minute north of the MIA Rental Car Center; 1.6 miles to the airport per the operator

hours.notes: The operator page says the lot “will be open to meet all of your parking needs, anytime of the day,” but it does not publish a 24/7 hours table, so we did not mark it open 24 hours. Confirm before a late-night return.

listings.shuttle: The shuttle picks you up at your vehicle, with luggage assistance from your car to the shuttle, per the operator page. Shuttle hours are not published.
listings.visitNotes: Scan your reservation QR code to enter and follow the signs. Park N Fly has combined with The Parking Spot; existing Park N Fly reservations are honored. The official MIA parking page links to theparkingspot.com under “Off-airport options.”
listings.feeNotes: The operator page does not publish a dated rate; your price depends on dates in the reservation tool.
